div.div: ضَرِجٌ A garment, or piece of cloth, smeared with a red, or yellow, colour; as also ↓ إِضْرِيجٌ : or this latter is only [applied to a garment, or piece of cloth,] of [the kind called] خَزّ. (TA.) [And ضَرِجُ الأَنَامِلِ means Having the ends of the fingers smeared, or defiled, by blood: see Ham p. 799.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
